why: the mirror of the 48%: properties the render REALIZES whose values exist only in shader code, with no declaration. An over-claiming contract is visible and reviewable; an under-declaring contract has nothing on the page to review, approve, or hand a supplier — the specification silently isn't one.

classes.DERIVATION_COEFFICIENT_UNDECLARED: a declared parameter reaches the shader only through an undeclared mapping — the physics of the mapping is itself unspecified contract
classes.INSTRUMENT_MACHINERY: determinism/seeding plumbing, not a material property

the_two_numbers_together: contract integrity, both directions: 40 of 84 declared parameters never reach the render (over-claim, visible once marked); 25 rendered properties/mappings exist only in builder code (under-declaration, invisible on the page). Several under-declared values carry banked verdicts: satin's roughness law, the flake roughness law, glitter's particle roughness and CHEBYCHEV shape law. The verdicts measured real frames and stand; the specification of what was measured lives half in code.

marbling_colour_authority_note.carried_forward_for_the_marbling_node: the marble palette is produced by UNDECLARED coefficients (*0.55 / *1.35+0.05) applied to PROVISIONAL shades — two layers from any authority, and the second layer is invisible on the page. COLOUR_AUTHORITY stands: pan_shades NO_AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_NEUTRAL_PLACEHOLDERS_ONLY, Pantone symbolic, FB3090 UNSOURCED. Fine as visualization; NOT a blocker on the marbling rig, whose question is chromatic-spatial structure. But the rig record must not let the derived colours read as a palette decision, and the two coefficients are declared as part of contract repair rather than discovered by whoever specifies a marbled shade to a supplier.
marbling_colour_authority_note.marbling_touches_contract_integrity_from: it is the only consumer of the common microtexture block (discharges that part of the over-claimed audit) AND the family whose colours sit in the under-declared half — the node is written once with both jobs in it.
